text:
maria.p: FYI hit an airgap + registry pull snag for Zephyr private rollout — nodes failing to fetch base image from our offline registry, getting TLS handshake errors.
aj: Which cert is failing? bootstrap image pull or node-agent sidecar?
suman: deploy-bot reported image pull timeout earlier, looks like 504-ish from the registry proxy. full error: `x509: certificate signed by unknown authority`
deploy-bot: deploy-job #423 failed: image_pull_error on zephyr-worker-7 — exit code 128, last log:
```
TLS handshake error: remote error: tls: bad certificate
```
nancy: I own the onprem handoff — not aware of recent CA rotations. last CA update was in infra vault on 3/2. I can rotate the registry CA if we confirm which cert chain node is rejecting.
aj: I can take firewall/nat checks. quick sanity: nodes can reach registry IP? `curl -v https://10.8.12.5:8443/` gives TLS handshake or resets?
maria.p: nodes can reach IP but handshake fails. ops-oncall ran `openssl s_client -connect 10.8.12.5:8443 -showcerts` and saw subject CN=registry.internal, issuer=internal-root-2022. nodes are pinned to old-root-2019.
ops-oncall: filing INF-2987 for NAT/proxy verification and INF-2988 for cert pin mismatch. tagging infra and security.
suman: FYI I have a quick PR that relaxes bootstrap verifier to include new-root until we rotate nodes — https://github.com/redwood-inference/ops-config/pull/489 PTAL @nancy @aj
nancy: will review PR now. if merged we can unblock bootstrap but need a follow-up to tighten the verifier and rotate node keystores.
aj: firewall side is fine, but we need to update egress ACLs for staging-to-registry path in prod-vpn; I put the config diff in the ticket.
maria.p: timeline ask — can we get a canary green by EOD Fri? if not, what's blocker list?
ops-oncall: blockers: 1) cert pin mismatch (security + ops) 2) offline registry proxy returning 504 under TLS handshake (registry team) 3) PR review for verifier relax (suman + nancy) 4) infra NAT config change deployment (aj)
suman: I'll rebase and attach smoke logs. trying to get PR -> staging patch today.
nancy: I can rotate registry cert chain midday, but need windows to update node trusts (will coordinate).
maria.p: great — I'll schedule a 3pm smoke and invite infra + registry + security. adding runbook: https://rwd.internal/runbooks/zephyr-airgap and INF tickets: INF-2987, INF-2988.
aj: pinging infra channel for NAT deploy slot.
maria.p: thanks all — updating the rollout doc and ownership table (maria.p: PM/rollout, nancy: onprem registry, aj: infra egress, suman: bootstrap verifier PR). will follow up after 3pm smoke. :thumbsup:
